references.text: Psalm 37:4 encourages finding joy in the Lord, and He will give you the desires of your heart, which is similar to the promise about the power of prayer in Matthew 21:22.
Mark 11:24 has a similar call to faith when praying, reflecting the message in Matthew 21:22 about the power of faith in prayer.
Isaiah 58:9 speaks of the Lord answering when one calls out, which can be seen in connection with the promise of answered prayer in Matthew 21:22.
John 14:13-14 states that Jesus will do what is asked in His name, reflecting the idea of faith and answered prayer in Matthew 21:22.
John 15:7 says that if one remains in Jesus and His words remain in them, they can ask for whatever they want and it will be done, which is similar to the promise in Matthew 21:22.
John 16:23-24 speaks of asking the Father in Jesus' name to receive, reflecting the themes of faith and prayer in Matthew 21:22.
Hebrews 11:6 states that it is impossible to please God without faith, emphasizing the importance of faith as mentioned in Matthew 21:22.
